headline: Nevish Line United Under Colonial Colours as Callums Cape Erupts
war_summary: Since our last edition the night has brought a fresh storm to Callums Cape, where better than twenty-five hundred casualties were logged in two hours and the flag changed hands at Scouts Jest shortly after one o'clock. The Nevish Line, lately swept by Colonial colours, now counts all eight of its posts under that flag, its ruined eighth base back in Colonial hands; the day's tally there stands at fifty-two flag events, though none has been logged in more than two hours and the hourly toll has fallen sharply. In the Weathered Expanse a third post lies in ruin, Wardens claimed ten of the day's captures against four, and a change of flag was recorded at the very minute of filing. Linn Mercy's fires have rekindled about Rotdust and Outwich Ranch, with hourly losses climbing steeply. Mooring County's flags have been quiet since nine o'clock, yet some four thousand casualties fell there in two hours, The Wind Hills the storm centre. Marban Hollow logged five flag changes in the two hours before dawn, Checkpoint Bua again the busiest ground. Callahans Passage and Stlican Shelf sit quiet, Briar untouched for ten hours. It is day 778 of the war; thirty-four victory towns must fall, and no victor is declared.
